title: Every Gromov elliptic domain is meromorphically pseudoconvex
summary: We prove that every Gromov elliptic domain $Ω$ in a complex manifold has the following property, which we call meromorphic pseudoconvexity: each boundary point has a neighborhood $V$ such that $Ω\cap V$ becomes Stein after removing a set which is, locally in $Ω\cap V$, the union of the polar sets of finitely many meromorphic functions on $Ω\cap V$.
